#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Random FIB/trace generator with round-trip verified addresses."""
import random, socket, struct

def words_of(upper, lower):
    return [(upper >> s) & 0xffff for s in (48, 32, 16, 0)] + \
           [(lower >> s) & 0xffff for s in (48, 32, 16, 0)]

def parse_back(text):
    b = socket.inet_pton(socket.AF_INET6, text)
    return struct.unpack(">Q", b[:8])[0], struct.unpack(">Q", b[8:])[0]

def fmt(upper, lower, rng):
    """Format an address; every result is verified to round-trip exactly."""
    w = words_of(upper, lower)
    cands = []
    cands.append(":".join("%x" % x for x in w))
    cands.append(":".join("%X" % x for x in w))
    # compressed: longest zero run
    best = None
    i = 0
    while i < 8:
        if w[i] == 0:
            j = i
            while j < 8 and w[j] == 0: j += 1
            if best is None or (j - i) > (best[1] - best[0]): best = (i, j)
            i = j
        else:
            i += 1
    if best and best[1] - best[0] >= 2:
        i, j = best
        left = ":".join("%x" % x for x in w[:i])
        right = ":".join("%x" % x for x in w[j:])
        cands.append((left + "::" + right) if (left and right) else (left + "::" + right))
    # ipv4-mapped / ipv4-compatible tails
    if w[4] == 0 and w[5] == 0xffff:
        cands.append("::ffff:%d.%d.%d.%d" % (w[6] >> 8, w[6] & 255, w[7] >> 8, w[7] & 255))
    if w[4] == 0 and w[5] == 0 and w[6] == 0 and w[7] != 0:
        cands.append("::%d.%d.%d.%d" % ((w[7] >> 24) & 255, (w[7] >> 16) & 255, (w[7] >> 8) & 255, w[7] & 255))
    if w[6] == 0xffff and w[7] != 0:
        cands.append("::ffff:%d.%d.%d.%d" % (w[6] >> 8, w[6] & 255, w[7] >> 8, w[7] & 255))
    ok = []
    for c in cands:
        try:
            if parse_back(c) == (upper, lower): ok.append(c)
        except socket.error:
            pass
    if not ok:
        return ":".join("%x" % x for x in w)  # full form always round-trips
    return rng.choice(ok)

def mask(upper, ln):
    if ln == 0: return 0
    return upper & ((((1 << ln) - 1) << (64 - ln)) & ((1 << 64) - 1))

def gen_fib(path, n, rng):
    seen = set()
    lines = []
    guard = 0
    while len(lines) < n and guard < 200 * (n + 10):
        guard += 1
        ln = rng.choice([0, 1, 2, 3, 4, rng.randrange(0, 65), rng.randrange(0, 65),
                         rng.randrange(8, 65), rng.randrange(32, 65), rng.randrange(48, 65),
                         64, 63, 62, 32, 33, 0])
        ln = max(0, min(64, ln))
        cnt = sum(1 for (u, l) in seen if l == ln)
        if cnt >= (1 << ln): continue
        upper = rng.getrandbits(64)
        lower = rng.getrandbits(64)
        start = mask(upper, ln)
        if (start, ln) in seen: continue
        seen.add((start, ln))
        hop = rng.choice([0, 1, 4294967295, rng.randrange(0, 1 << 32), rng.randrange(0, 256)])
        lines.append("%s/%d %d" % (fmt(upper, lower, rng), ln, hop))
    rng.shuffle(lines)
    open(path, 'w').write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")

def gen_trace(path, fib_prefixes, n, rng):
    lines = []
    for _ in range(n):
        if fib_prefixes and rng.random() < 0.75:
            s, ln = rng.choice(fib_prefixes)
            off = rng.getrandbits(64 - ln) if ln < 64 else 0
            upper = (s + off) & ((1 << 64) - 1)
        else:
            upper = rng.getrandbits(64)
        lower = rng.getrandbits(64)
        lines.append(fmt(upper, lower, rng))
    open(path, 'w').write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
